Rish local patch to gpui-pre-wgpu 0.3.6

Upstream and license
The 14 upstream files are copied from the registry package identified in
UPSTREAM.toml, including its normalized Cargo.toml, Cargo.toml.orig and full
Apache-2.0 license. The official crate archive was verified against the
checksum in the mobile workspace lockfile and compared byte for byte with
the source before modification. The archive contains no NOTICE or Cargo VCS
metadata. Its Cargo.lock is preserved as upstream package content; the
application resolves dependencies through apps/gpui/mobile/Cargo.lock.

Change
Only src/wgpu_context.rs is modified. In the native instance constructor,
Android removes InstanceFlags::DEBUG from the default flags. VALIDATION,
VALIDATION_INDIRECT_CALL and all other default flags are unchanged. Other
platforms keep the original default flags. The mobile workspace selects this
copy with its crates.io path patch; no global Cargo cache is modified.

Reason
wgpu-hal 29.0.4 uses DEBUG to request Naga SPIR-V debug records whose OpSource
language is WGSL (10). An Android API 34 arm64 emulator using the existing
SwiftShader backend reported "Invalid source language operand: 10" while
vkCreateGraphicsPipelines blocked the initial GPUI window creation. The
Android main thread then waited for the native event loop to acknowledge
Pause. This patch removes that diagnostic metadata without disabling GPU
validation, changing rendering shaders, or bypassing lifecycle acknowledgments.

Validation boundary
The package checksum, copied files, license, Android-only flag difference and
source formatting have been checked. A new Android renderer build and the two
real Activity lifecycle tests remain required. This compatibility patch alone
is not proof that the observed ANR is fixed. If pipeline creation still blocks
the event loop, renderer initialization must be addressed separately while
preserving normal NativeActivity lifecycle handling.
